name: Data Structures
description: Provides Drush/DrupalCodeGenerator generators and default classes to replace most uses of arrays in code with typed objects.
project_description: Data Structures is a developer utility module (no routes, permissions, config, or entities) that helps replace ad-hoc PHP arrays with type-safe objects. It ships two things: (1) two DrupalCodeGenerator generators, invoked through Drush 13's `drush generate` command, that scaffold value-map classes (`data-structures:map`) and typed immutable sequence classes (`data-structures:typed-sequence`) into a target module's `src/DataStructure/` directory; and (2) a small library of ready-to-use collection classes under the `Drupal\data_structures\DataStructure` namespace: five immutable typed sequences (Callable, Float, Int, Object, String) that enforce their element type in the constructor and reject mutation via ArrayAccess, plus a `Set`/`SetInterface` implementation providing uniqueness and set algebra (union, intersect, difference, symmetric difference) with an `EqualityInterface` for custom equality. The module is motivated by a performance study showing structured objects use substantially less memory than associative arrays. Requires PHP 8.3+ and Drush 13+.
